title: The Value an Operator Has Given Back on a Travel Protection Plans Claim
content:
The value the operator has given back, when a cancellation claim is rated on a Travel Protection Plans certificate, is read from the linked vacation package, one of the Vacation Package Products: its standing, the credit standing open against it, and the amounts it has returned to the traveller. Amounts returned are counted as positive amounts whichever way the package's own record carries them.

Where the linked package stands cancelled and a future travel credit stands open against it, the value the operator has given back is the amounts returned to the traveller together with the credit standing open, that credit taken at the share a credit is valued at.

Where the linked package stands cancelled and no future travel credit stands open against it, the value the operator has given back is the amounts returned to the traveller.

Where neither holds, none of the value the operator has given back is taken off.

## The three scopes

| Standing of the linked package | Credit standing open against it | The value the operator has given back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cancelled | Above nothing | The amounts returned to the traveller, together with the credit standing open taken at the share a credit is valued at |
| Cancelled | Nothing open | The amounts returned to the traveller |
| Any other standing | Either way | None of it is taken off |

## Reading the package

Both of the first two scopes require the package to stand cancelled; they are told apart by whether a future travel credit stands open against it. Where one does, it is brought in beside the money returned, but only at the share a credit is valued at, because a credit is not cash in hand.

Where the package stands in any other state, neither of the first two is reached, and nothing at all is taken off on this account, whatever the package's ledger may show returned.

Hypothetically, on a package standing cancelled with 1200.00 USD returned to the traveller and a credit of 800.00 USD standing open, valued at three quarters: the value the operator has given back is 1200.00 USD together with 600.00 USD, which is 1800.00 USD. With no credit open, it is 1200.00 USD. On a package standing as confirmed rather than cancelled, it is nothing at all.
